findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_checkout_options, create_upload · Private data: start_guest_checkout, create_agent_key, get_upload_status, import_photo, create_upload · Public sink: get_upload_status, import_photo, create_upload.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_checkout_options, create_upload · Private data: start_guest_checkout, create_agent_key, get_upload_status, import_photo, create_upload · Public sink: get_upload_status, import_photo, create_upload

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Public paginated product catalog, print specifications, and availability. Follow nextOffset until null. availableOnly defaults to true; false includes unavailable public products with explicit available flags. Filters cover query, category, finish, dimensions and known unit price range. capabilities" → after: "Browse available products, 4x6 first. Use returned products[].id for uploads and quotes. Filter by size, finish, category, price or query. Follow nextOffset; includeDetails:true adds artwork, shipping and fit specifications. availableOnly:false also includes unavailable public listings. Prices exclu"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
